name: Magic Minigame: Winchester Draft
oracle_text:
• 2 players • 6 packs • 30 min • Basic Lands
Objective:
Grab a friend and play some Magic in this quick, casual 2-player Draft format.
Get Ready:
Open 6 packs, remove all basic lands, ads, and tokens, and then shuffle the remaining cards together into a stack without looking at them. Place the stack face down, and then take the top four cards of the stack and place each one face up to create the beginnings of four separate piles.
Randomly determine who drafts first. The first player to draft chooses one of the four pikes and adds it to their draft pool. Place s a new card from the stack onto each pile, including the empty spot. Then it is the next player's turn to draft. They also draft an entire pile and then add new cards to each pile.
Take turns until all the cards have been drafted.
When drafting is done, each player builds a 40-card deck from their draft pool, including additional basic lands added as necessary.
Let's Play:
Randomly determine who goes first, then play a game of Magic!
Play a best-of-three match. Each player may sideboard using the rest of their drafted cards between games.
To Win:
The player who wins the best-of-three wins!

name: Magic Minigame: Strictly Better
oracle_text:
• 3-6 Players | • 3-6 Packs | • 15 minutes
OBJECTIVE:
Some cards are strong in Standard, others shine in Draft, but which card looks the tastiest? Take turns being the Judge and decide which Magic card is the best of the best in each wacky category.
GET READY:
Randomly determine who will be the first Judge. Each player then opens a pack and looks at their cards.
LET'S PLAY
The Judge chooses a category from the list on the back of this card (either their favorite or at random). The other players each secretly submit a card from their pack that they think fits the category.
When the Judge has collected all the cards, they reveal each card, read it aloud, then choose the winner.
The Judge role then passes to the next player, and they select a different category.
TO WIN:
The first player to win three categories is the winner!
CATEGORIES:
1. Best Castle
2. First Pick in Draft

rules_text:
• 3-6 Players | • 3-6 Packs | • 15 minutes
OBJECTIVE:
Some cards are strong in Standard, others shine in Draft, but which card looks the tastiest? Take turns being the Judge and decide which Magic card is the best of the best in each wacky category.
GET READY:
Randomly determine who will be the first Judge. Each player then opens a pack and looks at their cards.
LET'S PLAY
The Judge chooses a category from the list on the back of this card (either their favorite or at random). The other players each secretly submit a card from their pack that they think fits the category.
When the Judge has collected all the cards, they reveal each card, read it aloud, then choose the winner.
The Judge role then passes to the next player, and they select a different category.
TO WIN:
The first player to win three categories is the winner!

Randomly determine who goes first. Each player chooses which pile their opponent will use for each round. Then both players draw all three of their cards and play a game of Magic. When a player loses a game, they get to go first in the next game.
To Win:
The first player to win two games wins the match.
